title: Friction and Play in a Joint: Stick and Slip, a Gear With a Gap in It, and Which Encoder the Loop Should Watch

artifact.note: friction and play in an arm joint: a friction torque with a Coulomb part, a Stribeck part that falls with speed and a viscous part (the sign smoothed over a small speed), a motor and a load joined by a gear with a gap (a stiff contact only beyond the gap), a controller on either encoder with an option to add the friction torque for the velocity the reference asks, runs that track a slow ramp and hold a target, and the measurement of the gap from the motor's travel before the load moves
